title: trisetum barbinode var. hirtiflorum
intro: Trisetum barbinode var. hirtiflorum, commonly known as Chinese Needle Grass, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant is used in traditional Chinese medicine and is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Trisetum barbinode var. hirtiflorum are attributed to its ability to calm the nervous system, promote relaxation, and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
